name: TTP-TEAM-ACCOUNT
ttps: Accounts may be operated by teams, with the person interacting with recruiters changing by time of day; same-identity or same-network account clusters, one account using multiple network origins in a short interval, unusually long sessions, and unnaturally high cumulative work metrics are distinct combined-signal indicators.

sources.support: OFSI lists unusually long online activity, operation outside declared business hours, shared payment accounts, and shared devices as warning signs

The Canadian endpoint separately lists multiple accounts using one identity document or network origin, one account using multiple network origins in a short period, an unusually long login session, unnaturally high cumulative work metrics, and team-operated accounts; these are combined warning characteristics, not proof by themselves
sources.locator: For companies operating online platforms; For those hiring or procuring services

sources.support: The Japanese alert lists shared identifiers and network patterns, including multiple accounts associated with the same IP address, as warning signs
The joint alert describes accounts operated collectively, including changes in the person interacting with a client or recruiter over the course of a day
